intro: One grilled ikan kembung is about 200 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the fish itself, which is high in protein.

breakdown.part: Turmeric marinade and a brush of oil
A little air asam or sambal

variants.name: Wrapped in banana leaf, no oil

diet: Definitely. Grilled ikan kembung is high in protein, low in calories and has good fats from the fish. It's one of the most diet-friendly lauk at any warung. Just watch the sambal brushed on top, because that's what adds oil.
tips: Choose air asam or kicap cili over oily sambal.
Have 1 fish with half a plate of rice and ulam.
At home, grill it in the air fryer or oven with just turmeric and salt.

swap.name: Ikan kembung bakar wrapped in banana leaf
swap.why: No brushed oil, but still fragrant with the same protein.

faq.q: Is ikan kembung high in omega-3?
faq.a: Yes, ikan kembung is one of the local fish rich in omega-3, and it's affordable too.

faq.q: How do I know if ikan kembung is fresh?
faq.a: Clear eyes, red gills and firm flesh when pressed. It should smell like the sea, not strongly fishy.

faq.q: What goes well with ikan bakar?
faq.a: White rice, air asam, ulam and vegetables. Many also eat it with sambal kicap and cucumber.
